Grace didn't come back after the break, no call, nothing, and I found out through the grapevine, her friend is also my client, which I know is messy, that's its own thing, that she moved to a different therapist because mine was 'too structured,' which stings a bit but fair enough, I run a tight session. I processed it in my own supervision slot, the sting, the rejection thing, and Barb was helpful, she said some clients need a different hand and it's not a verdict on my work. I'm sending Grace a closure letter, brief, door open, no pressure, and I'll archive her chart with a note about the transfer. Also her friend, my other client, I need to watch that boundary carefully, no information flows either way, and I should probably name it with her at some point. That's the day. Tomorrow is notes and the insurance portal, and I'm going to bed.

The dual relationship with the friend-client requires careful boundary watching; no information flows either way.
